verdict.rationale: Flagsmith does not document explicit region/residency selection in its managed cloud (e.g., EU vs US hosting options), but self-hosting (docs-12, docs-13) and the Edge Proxy (docs-14, docs-28) let a customer run the entire platform in their own infrastructure/location, effectively giving full control over where data lives. This is an indirect, workaround-based path to data residency rather than a built-in region picker in the SaaS product. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of selectable cloud regions/data residency options for the hosted/managed offering, and any compliance certifications tied to specific regions.
